title: Job Board Keyword Scanner
one_line: Scan a company's job postings for the specific words that indicate a problem your product solves.
description: Scan a company's job postings for the specific words that indicate a problem your product solves. Use when someone wants to find companies mentioning a tool, a process, or a pain in their job ads, or wants keyword based intent rather than role based intent.
paragraph: Role titles are a coarse signal. The precise one lives in the body of the posting, where a company names the tool it is migrating off, the process it is trying to build, or the metric it is being measured on. This skill scans postings for a keyword set you define and reports which company said what, with the sentence around it.
keywords: scan job descriptions for a phrase
